links.outcome: Rater-scored safety, usability and smoothness of knowledge-graph-grounded QA versus the same LLMs without RAG
links.effect: Safety 2.868 vs 1.57-1.74 and usability 2.848 vs 1.55-1.67 for LLMs without RAG; smoothness 2.98 vs 2.13-2.21 (3-point scale, 5 TCM evaluators, 20 questions). RAGAS faithfulness 0.9375.
links.quote: Overall, the traditional Chinese medicine case-based Q&A system, based on LLMs and knowledge graphs, provides outstanding performance in terms of security, professionalism, and fluency, significantly outperforming traditional Q&A systems that rely solely on LLMs, and has enormous potential for application.

links.outcome: Unsafe or inaccurate standalone LLM answers
links.effect: Standalone LLMs scored below acceptable (2) for safety 1.57–1.74 and usability 1.55–1.67 on the 1–3 SUS scale.
links.quote: This is something traditional LLMs (e.g., GPT-3.5-Turbo and GLM-3-Turbo) cannot achieve, as these models typically lack specialized knowledge in the field of traditional Chinese medicine and are prone to generating inaccurate answers in this area.
